pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Complex polygonal geometries with highly serrated, dendritic edges characterized by fine-scale 'oak-leaf' protrusions. Patch area is maximal on the mid-flank and reduces in scale towards the ventral midline and proximal limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-toned pathways forming a topological web. Junction nodes predominantly feature tri-radial intersections. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-section, maintaining a clear separation of dark patch boundaries.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude serrated 1D contour along the dorsal neck and shoulder, defined by the terminal tips of the short-haired mane against the low-contrast background.
